name: Watercolor Bleed
desc: Layered watercolor pigment blooms — recursively deformed organic polygons stacked in translucent multiply layers so overlaps deepen into mottled wet-edged washes that breathe and drift across warm paper; renders as jewel pigment, sunset, botanical, tonal monochrome, or sumi ink.

density.doc: how many pigment blooms (more = fuller page)

warp.doc: edge irregularity (how ragged/organic the wash edges)
